newsitem.title: USA: Clorox sees good full-year results.
newsitem.headline: Clorox sees good full-year results.

text.p: Clorox Co, reporting record second quarter earnings, said Thursday it expects good full-year results, despite costs for an acquisition and new product launches.
Clorox said its purchase of Armor All, completed in January, would dilute second half earnings by about $0.15 a share. The company's fiscal year ends in June.

"Even with the effect of Armor All, and expenses associated with our heavy new product schedule, we expect fiscal 1997 to be another good year in terms of earnings growth and preparing the business for more profitable growth in the longer term," Chief Executive Craig Sullivan said.
The Armor All acquisition adds a line of automotive cleaning products to Clorox's product line-up, as well as $48 million in cash.
Clorox said it plans to ship eight new domestic products and three new international products during its fiscal third quarter.
New products in the United States include bleaches, carpet cleaner, bottled salad dressing and barbecue sauce, and a pitcher.
Clorox shares were up 3/4 at 104-1/8 at mid-morning.

"We're pleased with our year-to-date progress and the continued strength of our overall business," Sullivan said. "Second quarter shipments were up across the board for all of our major operating units."
He said the company's international business achieved substantial volume gains, driven primarily by growth in Latin American operations.
Higher product volumes and improved gross margins also helped produce the record second quarter results, despite a 21 percent increase in advertising costs, Sullivan said.
Clorox 2 color-safe bleach shipped its highest volumes since the second quarter of fiscal 1994, and Hidden Valley bottled salad dressing also grew strongly.
New products S.O.S. scrubber sponges, Fresh Scent Clorox Clean-Up, Professional Strength Tilex, and Clorox Automatic Toilet Bowl Cleaner Blue plus Bleach helped drive earnings.
Acquisitions in Latin America helped drive product sales in that region, Clorox said.
In Chile, Clorox added a window cleaner, insecticide and air freshener. In Argentina it added a pine cleaner to its line of bleaches, home cleaning products and insecticides.
